protocol.selection: Choose each checkpoint by validation MSE. Fix the comparison before evaluating the saved test rows.
protocol.scope: 500-bin recorded-unit raw/reference lineshape regression without TE calibration; hold out whole source scans, including all simulated descendants.

provenance.timing_scope: Training loop, including validation and best-state copies; excludes data loading and feature/ridge fitting

evaluation.decision: All declared architectures retained after validation; no architecture or setting changes. Evaluate each best-validation checkpoint once on the same saved test rows.

units: P is fractional; displayed absolute errors multiply by 100 to give percentage points
limitations: One training seed and a common budget; no claim that depth or convolution always improves accuracy
CNN includes a train-only ridge fit to 25 physical summaries; gains are not attributable to convolutions alone
Recorded-unit raw/reference inputs without TE calibration; source-scan grouped synthetic holdout, not experimental accuracy
Controlled sensitivity coverage; no measured material-specific accuracy
